title: Southern Cal. anglers are catching unusually large & rare fish
summary_full: In Southern California, local fishermen are delighted to encounter a surge of warm-water fish species, an effect of rising ocean temperatures associated with El Niño and marine heatwaves. This change has drawn in fish like yellowtail and bonito, which are often absent from these waters. However, while this provides thrilling fishing options, it’s crucial to remember that previous events like this have resulted in serious environmental repercussions.
